kind: routine accounting convention; no acceptance/design or ceiling change

decode_depth.boundary: depth <= configured maximum; next unwrap beyond maximum refuses

decoded_nodes.unit: dict/list/scalar occurrence observed in a decoded walk
decoded_nodes.scope: cumulative in one invocation across all members and additional decoded representations
decoded_nodes.boundary: nodes <= configured maximum; next counted occurrence refuses

zip_limits: archive_bytes/expanded_bytes/zip_entries are separate; decode_depth does not count ZIP envelope

real_newman_structural_twin.note: This measurement only walks base parsed dict/list/scalars; ordinary structural nesting spends no unwrap depth. Existing Buffer/nested JSON carriers are separately decoded and counted by the eventual scanner; this record does not claim an implemented scanner result.
